notes.title: 1.1.2 Update. UI & Sounds & Effects
notes.content:
[h3]Focus of this update to make game easier and more comfortable for all players.[/h3]

[h2]Sound perspective[/h2]
- Added full sound coverage to UI of all game, including Main menu, Victory, Death of player, Upgrades, and a lot more 
- Added sounds when picking cards / upgrades
- Sound when player takes damage slightly reworked
- Added soundtrack to Main Menu and Victory
- All soundtrack was changed to NO-Copyright songs to avoid further issues

[h2]New players perspective[/h2]
There's was a lot of missing feedback from the game like:
- lack of progression feeling
- Ammo and Weapon problems.

So i decided to add some new features like:
- Error inciating type of ammo you lack to shoot from that weapon and how to change weapon to another
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/660d93b4e3fd2af7f7444c647a8f132cd51278b3.png[/img]
- Each weapon you buy will be automatically picked up
- Upgrade button onDeath and after Victory which indicates you can spend essence which you just earned
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/ceee1d5d2397f1f1b1578b03ef17a4e46efcc6d6.png[/img]
- Rework of Victory Scene, it will give more feeling of progress and achivement of beating the game
- Weapon shop will ALWAYS sell weapons untill you bought any 2, but prices still increasing with level


[h2]Feedback's perspective[/h2]
- Added screenshake to some events: player dies, player Defeats a boss
- Effect of vignette when player at low health
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/d3b9d3eb6a4a05ec2b11357c0492d00a3f7b0d94.png[/img]
- Player Death new effect/UI and more remarkable
- Added conveyor of enemies to some scenes, which changes with each difficulty you beat
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/0d1095f4c5a775bff7afe35d54440c1c21b805ce.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/7f77a688a011ac6ad389ce97ec70f4406efade78.png[/img]



[h2]Balance & minor features[/h2]
- Speed of spending essence was changed: the more you press the faster it goes
- Big improvement to LaserSniper gun, now its just obliterates enemies[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/6838138ace74cd9f8c6fa226aec68fc6842a406b.png[/img]
-slightly decreased ammo per pack of lightning
- Big upgrade of final boss, especially boosted versions [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44718722/65d891ba39a45b9377b244d125e2bbf732609219.png[/img]
Chaser HP 700 -> 2000
Shields of Chaser HP 400 -> 1000
Sniper HP 700 -> 1800
Sniper now shoots 2 times in a burst mode
